name: open-manga-v1
purpose: Visibility Phase 2, Slice J1-Manga. A deterministic, disk-only manga CHAPTER download (Tankoban chapter lane, MangaDownloader-backed, NOT the tankoban VOLUME lane) so an isolated Lanista session can drive the real Downloads page to a genuinely ready comic reader without touching any registry-backed store.
provenance: Authored fresh for J1-Manga (2026-08-13) — not lifted from a real-bug dossier. Not promoted into tests/lanista-seeds/ in this slice.

layout.pages: manga/journey-manga-series-v1/ch-1/page_000.png .. page_002.png (real decodable PNGs, copied byte-for-byte from tests/fixtures/tankoban/tiny-volume.cbz's three page entries)

whyChapterLaneNotVolumeLane: The Tankoban VOLUME lane (MangaVolumeIndex/TankobanVolumes) and the Library tab both require a Collection entry to render a library row; Collection (native/CollectionStore.h) is QSettings("Brotherhood","Colosseum") — Windows-registry-backed, hardcoded org/app, NOT re-rooted by COLOSSEUM_APPDATA_TAG — so it cannot be seeded via --seed and must never be written by an automated session (it is Hemanth's real, live registry data, shared with the daily app).

The Continue-card resume path (the OTHER way a volume opens deterministically) reads the same-shaped ProgressStore, which is also QSettings("Brotherhood","Colosseum") — same registry-backed, same unseedable, same do-not-mutate constraint.

The Downloads page's own generic route for a volume-lane row (Main.qml routeDownloadItem -> openSeriesAt) hardcodes openEntryKind="manga" regardless of the row's actual lane, which would open a real 'tankoban:' volume id through the wrong page store (Downloads/MangaDownloader instead of TankobanVolumes) and never reach a genuine readerReady — a pre-existing routing gap outside this slice's fence, not something this slice may fix.

MangaDownloader (native/engine/MangaDownloader.h/.cpp) is the one manga store that is plain-file-backed (<AppDataLocation>/manga/index.json + loose page files) with NO Collection/Progress dependency anywhere in its read path, and DownloadsPage's routing for a chapter-lane row (kind:"manga") already calls openSeriesAt with the CORRECT entryKind — so this is the only lane with a real, deterministic, registry-free, network-free path from a seeded fixture to a genuinely ready reader.
